title: Physical Therapy & Rehab Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: MedBridge exercises (`medbridge:exercise`), PT clinic sessions (`pt:session`), Hinge Health sessions (`hingehealth:session`), rehab range-of-motion logs (`rehab:rom`), and pain diary entries (`pain:diary`).
app: MedBridge exercise completions, clinic PT session exports, Hinge Health digital sessions, ROM measurement logs, and pain diary entries forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=pain:diary) OR (index=personal sourcetype=medbridge:exercise))
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="pain:diary","primary",sourcetype="medbridge:exercise)","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from pain:diary and medbridge:exercise) to see whether two physical therapy feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `pain:diary` and `medbridge:exercise)` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main physical therapy data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
